latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the event-driven issue creation workflow controller.

- Enables trigger via Gitea webhook (on renaming draft_issue.md to confirmed_issue.md) or through OpenClaw chat commands.
- Automates strict workflow: precondition check, issue creation, dependency linking, status update, and email notification.
- Differentiates between single-project and cross-project meetings, handling each with appropriate branching logic.
- Provides robust error handling with user feedback and ensures idempotency at all stages.
- Includes detailed configuration and setup instructions for seamless deployment.
